ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What represents primary producers in the diagram?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a food web or trophic level schematic diagram, with a group of plant patterns at the bottom, labeled beside them as “primary producers (plants)”. Above the plants are “detritivores”, and further up are biological categories such as “carnivores”, connected by arrows. Reasoning: The question asks what in the figure represents primary producers. According to the label at the bottom of the figure, the parentheses after “primary producers” say “plants”, and the corresponding patterns are also plants. Therefore the answer is plants.
